definitions: Having severe difficulty breathing because of an obstruction in your throat or because of a lack of air.
To make someone unable to breathe by squeezing their throat.
To fill a space so as to make movement difficult or impossible.
To fail to perform effectively at a critical moment due to nervousness.
examples: He started choking on a piece of food.
The attacker was choking him with a rope.
The weeds were choking the pond.
The team was choking under pressure in the final minutes.
